purpose: Defines how the consult skill behaves when delegated from the review skill, covering received findings, display format, bulk-fix offer, brief recording via script, and the result returned to review.
summary: Handling of received findings: topics needing user decision versus report-only items
Order by evaluator severity: critical, major, minor
Presentation state kept only in conversation context and not persisted
Consult does not execute decisions; review core executes them
Display format with two-line overview, horizontal table, and bulleted current topic
Bulk-fix offer for correct and safely fixable findings, excluding flawed premises
Recording of consult brief via Write and a recording script with exit-code handling
Secret values must not appear in the brief
Result returned to review: adoption decisions and settlement status
tasks: Running consult when delegated from review
Presenting review findings to the user for adoption decisions
Recording consult briefs with the recording script
Returning decisions to the review core
title: review から委譲されたときの手順
